description: This Java class 'JunitSuiteWrapper' is used to load, manage, and retrieve JUnit test suites based on XML configurations within the Apache OFBiz framework. It interacts with component configurations, resource handlers, and DOM elements to assemble test cases for execution.

classes.name: JunitSuiteWrapper
classes.description: A utility class to load and manage JUnit test suites based on XML configurations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: JunitSuiteWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the test suite list by reading XML test suite configurations for a given component, filtering by suite name and test case.

methods.name: populateTestSuite
methods.description: Deprecated method to add all test cases from the internal list to a given TestSuite object.

methods.name: getModelTestSuites
methods.description: Returns the list of loaded ModelTestSuite objects.

methods.name: getAllTestList
methods.description: Returns a list of all Test objects from the loaded test suites.
